description: This file defines an interface class 'SharedFdKeymasterChannel' for communication over shared file descriptors used in Keymaster IPC/RPC calls within the Android platform. It declares methods for sending requests and responses, and receiving messages, utilizing shared file descriptors for synchronous communication.

classes.name: SharedFdKeymasterChannel
classes.description: Interface class for Keymaster communication over shared file descriptors, inherits from KeymasterChannel.

methods.name: SharedFdKeymasterChannel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with input and output shared file descriptors.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a command and serializable message over the channel.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a command and serializable message over the channel.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the channel.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Private helper function that actually sends a message with command, response flag, and message.
